basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old avid gamer based in Portland, Oregon. I've always been passionate about video games, especially those with rich graphics and immersive storylines. When I'm not gaming, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me to appreciate the visual artistry in games. I suffer from chronic back pain, which limits my physical activities, so gaming has become my primary form of relaxation and escape. I'm mostly online in the evenings after work, from around 6 PM to midnight PST. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my free time exploring new games and engaging with the online community.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having studied at a local college and worked in various freelance projects. My knowledge of gaming comes from years of playing and keeping up with industry news. I often research new technologies and gaming platforms, which has given me a decent understanding of the tech behind gaming.
